summary: Mangold Fondkommission AB provides financial services to companies, institutions, and private individuals in Sweden. It operates in two segments, Investment Banking and Private Banking. The company offers investment banking services, such as corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, issuing, commissioned research, certified adviser, mentor Nordic growth market SME, liquidity provider, and qualified adviser services. It also provides private banking services, including wealth advisory, securities trading, and portfolio management services. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Mangold Fondkommission AB operates as a subsidiary of Mangold Ab.
